name: NEXGRAM
recent: 并将在 2027 年 1 月 21 日的股东大会上寻求批准。公司委任大股东 Cheang Soon Siang 为集团董事经理，同时有多项董事及大股东股权变动申报。最新季度（2026 年 7 月 31 日止）营收环比增长 42.4%，同比增长 82.8%，但净利同比下滑 82.7%。
notable: 委任大股东 Cheang Soon Siang 为集团董事经理。
Cheang Soon Siang 在公开市场进行多项股权交易，包括间接增持 55,975,003 股（5.725%）。
risks: 董事经理 Cheang Soon Siang 在 2026 年 11 月 25 日至 26 日期间有多笔间接股权交易。
Tuan Haji Mazru Bin Mat Yusof 于 2026 年 10 月 15 日申报不再是大股东。
earnings: 2026 年 7 月 31 日止季度营收为 MYR 22,890,527，环比增长 42.4%，同比增长 82.8%；净利为 MYR 3,876,406，净利率 16.9%，但净利同比下滑 82.7%。

recent_en: Nexgram proposes to change its name to Neu Atlantic Group Berhad, to be tabled at the AGM on 21 Jan 2027. The company appointed substantial shareholder Cheang Soon Siang as Group Managing Director, alongside several director and substantial shareholder interest change announcements. Latest quarter (ended 31 Jul 2026) revenue rose 42.4% QoQ and 82.8% YoY, while net profit fell 82.7% YoY.
notable_en: Proposed name change from Nexgram Holdings Berhad to Neu Atlantic Group Berhad.
Appointed substantial shareholder Cheang Soon Siang as Group Managing Director.
Cheang Soon Siang conducted several open-market share dealings, including indirect acquisition of 55,975,003 shares (5.725%).
risks_en: Group Managing Director Cheang Soon Siang had multiple indirect share dealings on 25-26 Nov 2026.
Tuan Haji Mazru Bin Mat Yusof ceased to be a substantial shareholder, as announced on 15 Oct 2026.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 31 Jul 2026, revenue was MYR 22,890,527, up 42.4% QoQ and 82.8% YoY; net profit was MYR 3,876,406 with a net margin of 16.9%, while net profit fell 82.7% YoY.
